name: agentguards-claude
description: LLM security guardrails for Claude Code — jailbreak detection, prompt-injection and web-content scanning, data-exfiltration blocking, and destructive-command authorization. Bundles the AgentGuards MCP server plus enforcing hooks.

agentguards_api_key.title: AgentGuards API key
agentguards_api_key.description: Optional fallback for the hooks when AGENTGUARDS_API_KEY is not already set. The easiest way to set your key is to run /agentguards:setup in an Agent Mode or Local Code session and let Claude save it for you. Note the Claude Desktop app never reads a shell profile, so an export will not reach it.
